title: rosa micrantha subsp. lemanii
intro: Rosa micrantha subsp. lemanii, commonly known as the Italian rose or Rosa lemanii, is a species of rose that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa micrantha subsp. lemanii include wound healing, anti-aging, and the treatment of various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
